## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

Just a demo! We're working on this man

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

```

## How many species in the data set?

```{r}
penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(avg_bill = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Body mass by species

```{r}
penguins |>
  ggplot(mapping=aes(x=species, y=body_mass_g),
  fill = species)+
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(title = "Penguin Body Mass by Specieis", x = "Species", y= "Something else")
```
